source_caption:
Key & Peele is a comedy show created by and starring Keegan-Michael Key and Jordan Peele. It features short sketches that mix absurd humor with sharp social commentary on topics like race, identity, and everyday life.

The show blew up for its viral sketches—like the intense substitute teacher and the exaggerated football introductions. Its mix of smart writing, cringe comedy, and over-the-top characters made it stand out and keeps it widely popular online.
